# Template write no-op: re-writing a template whose YAML and both mockups are
# byte-identical to the committed files succeeds as an 'unchanged' no-op
# instead of failing with an empty commit. Every mockup validation still runs
# before the no-op decision.

exec akb init noop-kb
cd noop-kb
env AKB_KB=.

# Seed a template and its pass mockup from the embedded showcase set.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout note.yaml
exec akb template get note --example --examples
cp stdout note_pass.md

# The first write installs and commits the template and its mockups.
exec akb template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md
stdout 'Template .note. written'
exec git log --oneline
cp stdout history.txt

# The byte-identical --force re-run is a no-op: exit 0, the 'unchanged'
# message, no new commit, and the installed files untouched.
exec akb template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md --force
stdout 'Template .note. unchanged'
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout history.txt
cmp note.yaml .akb/templates/note.yaml
cmp note_pass.md .akb/templates/note_pass.md

# The same byte-identical re-run with the persistent --no-commit flag is
# still a no-op: exit 0, the 'unchanged' message, and no new commit.
exec akb --no-commit template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md --force
stdout 'Template .note. unchanged'
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout history.txt

# Different mockup content is a real write again, and is recorded in a commit.
exec akb template write note --template note.yaml --pass ../changed-pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md --force
stdout 'Template .note. written'
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: template write note'

# Validation still runs before the no-op decision: a committed template whose
# pass mockup violates its own rule is refused even though every byte matches
# what the write would record.
cp ../planted.yaml .akb/templates/planted.yaml
cp ../planted_pass.md .akb/templates/planted_pass.md
cp ../planted_fail.md .akb/templates/planted_fail.md
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'plant a template whose pass mockup violates its rule'
! exec akb template write planted --template ../planted.yaml --pass ../planted_pass.md --fail ../planted_fail.md --force
stderr 'pass mockup no longer validates'
! stderr 'unchanged'

# A first write with the persistent --no-commit flag leaves the template files
# uncommitted. A byte-identical --force --no-commit re-run must still exit 0
# without reaching git with an empty change set, and must leave the installed
# files untouched.
cd ..
exec akb init nocommit-kb
cd nocommit-kb
env AKB_KB=.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout note.yaml
exec akb template get note --example --examples
cp stdout note_pass.md
exec git log --oneline
cp stdout history-nocommit.txt
exec akb --no-commit template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md
stdout 'Template .note. written'
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout history-nocommit.txt
exec git status --porcelain -- .akb/templates
stdout '\?\? .akb/templates/'
exec akb --no-commit template write note --template note.yaml --pass note_pass.md --fail ../note-fail.md --force
stdout 'Template .note. written'
! stderr 'nothing to commit'
exec git log --oneline
cmp stdout history-nocommit.txt
cmp note.yaml .akb/templates/note.yaml
cmp note_pass.md .akb/templates/note_pass.md
cmp ../note-fail.md .akb/templates/note_fail.md

-- note-fail.md --
---
type: note
title: ""
summary: A note whose title is empty
tags: [test]
---

# Empty title

This note fails require_title because the title is an empty string.

-- changed-pass.md --
---
type: note
title: Test Note
summary: A note whose mockup gained a summary
tags: [test]
---

# Test Note

This is a valid note.

-- planted.yaml --
name: planted
description: Template planted with a pass mockup that violates its rule
schema:
  frontmatter:
    title:
      type: string
      required: true
validations:
  - id: title_not_planted
    rule: 'page.frontmatter.title != "Planted"'
    expect: title must differ from "Planted"

-- planted_pass.md --
---
type: planted
title: Planted
---

# Planted title

This pass mockup violates title_not_planted, so a template write must refuse it.

-- planted_fail.md --
---
type: planted
title: Planted
---

# Planted title

This fail mockup fails title_not_planted, which is what a fail mockup is for.
